label: The defining sum
subgoals: Use the definition of an ellipse

visual.title: The constant focal sum
visual.caption: An ellipse is the set of points whose distances to two fixed foci add to a constant. For x²/2 + y² = 1, a = √2, b = 1 and c = 1, so the foci are (0, ±1). Every point on the curve satisfies PF1 + PF2 = 2a = 2√2, even though the two distances change.

predict.question: As the probe moves around this ellipse, what happens to PF1 + PF2?
predict.explain: The defining property of an ellipse is a constant focal sum, PF1 + PF2 = 2a. Here 2a = 2√2; only the separate distances change.
